drills.prompt: Tell me about a time you resolved a conflict between design and engineering on a tight deadline.
drills.candidateAnswer: We had two weeks before launch. Design wanted a new onboarding carousel; engineering flagged risk. I facilitated a one-hour workshop, we cut scope to one screen, shipped on time, and activation went up 6%.

followUps.question: What was your specific role versus the EM's?
How did you measure activation — cohort and window?

drills.coachNotes: Good outcome metric; clarify personal actions in workshop facilitation.
